evidence.detail: The class imports only rs.d.r and every mutating entry point accepts an rs.d.r instance plus its definition id. Exact-v308 rs.d.r owns the object-definition model/action/transform state and is paired with R80 ObjectDefinitionConfigLoader rs/t/a/f.

The recovered class is ~72 KB and contains a hard-coded switch over roughly 680 object definition ids. Each matched id mutates definition fields such as model arrays, action arrays and other presentation/interaction properties.

The public apply path first runs the large common override switch and then applies additional id-specific model-array replacements for ids including 6926, 11986, 38847/38848, 41451/41453 and 42517/42518.
The class owns no cache, parser or instance state; it is a pure static post-decode customization layer over ObjectDefinition instances rather than the definition loader itself.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the hard-coded post-decode ObjectDefinition override/customization layer. No original stripped developer identifier is claimed.
